'''Donari Caron''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltron]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who was affiliated with the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal organization, and she operated from the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Touch of Gold]]''. In about [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], Caron met with the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Black market/Legends|black market]] [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] [[Acer Ash]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], to broker an agreement with him to swap some [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeological]] artifacts that she had recently acquired for some experimental [[Ray shield/Legends|energy shields]] that he possessed. During the course of their negotiations, Caron repeatedly attempted to use her pheromones to influence Ash, and he revealed to her that he knew of an attempt on the life of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] that was scheduled to take place. Caron and Ash eventually agreed to exchange an energy shield one of her paintings, and she subsequently passed on intelligence of the impending [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] attempt to the Black Sun [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] [[Tyno Fabris]].
